title: NSWC B1000 D/50 Lab Relocations
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVFAC.NAVFAC ATLANTIC CMD.NAVFAC MID-ATLANTIC.NAVFACSYSCOM MID-ATLANTIC
description_text: The intent of this contract opportunity is to provide renovation/modernization for a new computer laboratory on the third floor of Building 1000 at the Philadelphia Navy Yard for the Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD), in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Building 1000 is utilized by NSWC as a research, development, testing and evaluation facility. The products listed below are required to meet the readiness requirements for the Customer by meeting their APL for ESS. 1. ID Factors 2-Factor Card Reader –Model 74-01-2003 2.Lenel Power Supply Enclosure – Model LNLAL600ULX-4CB6 3. Lenel Access Control SystemDual Controller – Model LNL-X2220 4. Lenel Access Control System Dual Reader Interface Module – Model LNL-1100- S3 5. Bosch Request to Exit Device – Model DS-160 6. HES Electric Strike – Model HES-1006 7. Magnasphere Balanced Magnetic Switch- Model HSS-L2S-000\ 8. Lenel Access Control Power Supply– Model AL600ULPD8CB
